titulo: 3.4.5 Apocalypse Update Details [Patch applied, restart to play]
html:
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.

The time has come to face the most dangerous of foes. The one who goes by many names, The Eternal One, The Savior, The First Mutant, En Sabah Nuhr. Many names have been given, but only one of them truly captures his presence. Apocalypse. It is time to face off against one of Earths greatest threats and save the world one more time.

Patch Period:
09/27 06:00 AM ~ 06:30 AM (UTC+0)
09/26 23:00 ~ 23:30 (PDT)
※We will be informing you once the Patch is finished.

Update Rewards

Although there was no maintenance for these characters, we will still be distributing a reward for the update. You can collect these rewards from the notice section in-game. 

Rewards: 
Energy x150
Clear Tickets x30 

These items can be collected during the following period: 
09/27 06:30 ~ 09/29 14:59 (UTC+0)
09/26 11:30PM ~ 09/29 07:59AM (PDT) 

1. New World Boss Stage Added
Take on Apocalypse in his all new World Boss Stage. Once the mode has been unlocked, you are free to challenge the greatest threat to mankind. Are you made of the right stuff to take him down?

※ Apocalypse is available only by completing his World Boss Stage
※ Apocalypse follows the leveling up method of Jean Grey.

 - As Apocalypse has been added, new achievements and team up bonuses have been added.

※ Stats are based on Skill Level 1.

2. 2 New Uniforms

New uniforms for Wolverine and Rogue have been added.

※ New Uniforms are available at discounted price for a certain period.
※ Check out new Uniforms in Uniform Room to see the details.
※ New Uniforms do not change the characters typing or their type.

 


※ Stats are based on Skill Level 1.
